comparison.intent: Concise adjacent-product distinction, not direct substitution

comparison.decision: Choose Clean Sweep for its documented similar-media/contact job if platform and purchase conditions fit. Consider Breathing Room, which we build, for broader Mac storage/activity investigation with preview and hosted-AI caveats. Do not claim it replaces contact merging or photo matching.

advantagesAndTradeoffs.text: Clean Sweep's documented specialised media/contact scope and cross-device purchase restoration may fit a library-organisation job better than a general maintenance preview; restoration and Family Sharing are not tested.

Breathing Room's documented storage/activity investigation is a different job, not evidence of superior media deduplication. Its non-notarized preview, Python prerequisite and hosted AI are material trade-offs.
